pages.title: Ashlord
pages.text: First, these opponents must be defeated in this world: Withered Abomination, Lava Eater, Piglin Executioner, Furnace. Take part in the first victory over Ashlord or remain near the encounter. A rematch does not award a new advancement.
This reusable locator marks the encounter and opens the map. Look for it among cartographer and wandering-trader offers; it does not replace the encounter’s own awakening method.
